title: 684. Non-decreasing Array

examples.explanation: Two separate drops need two edits.
Fixing either drop leaves another violation.

hints: Scan for the first index i with nums[i] > nums[i+1]; more than one such spot (after a fix) means failure.
At a violation, either lower nums[i] to nums[i+1] or raise nums[i+1] to nums[i] — pick the one keeping neighbours valid.
Lowering the left entry works when i is 0 or nums[i-1] <= nums[i+1]; otherwise raise the right entry.
